description: This script generates a test suite from NIST PKITS test descriptions, parsing a PDF converted to text and producing C++ test code with GoogleTest framework. It handles test case parsing, overrides for specific tests, and outputs formatted test registration code.

classes.name: TestSections
classes.description: Holds parsed sections of a test case including description, procedure, expected result, and certification path lines.

classes.name: TestInfo
classes.description: Defines the input and expected output parameters for a test case, including validation expectation and policy settings.

methods.name: sanitize_name
methods.description: Removes spaces and hyphens from a string to create a sanitized test name.

methods.name: finalize_test_case
methods.description: Writes the registration of a test case with its sanitized test names into the output.

methods.name: bool_to_str
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to 'true' or 'false' string.

methods.name: make_policies_string
methods.description: Joins a list of policies into a comma-separated string enclosed in quotes.

methods.name: output_test
methods.description: Generates a test case code block with test parameters and appends it to the output.

methods.name: parse_main_test_sections
methods.description: Extracts description, procedure, expected result, and certification path lines from the test text.

methods.name: parse_cert_path_lines
methods.description: Parses certification path lines into separate certificate and CRL lists.

methods.name: parse_test
methods.description: Parses individual test cases, handling overrides and generating test code accordingly.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that converts PDF to text, extracts test sections, and generates C++ test code with GoogleTest.
